CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.
   D. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

12. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)

14. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

15. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items
